SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(lpm) AS numeric), 2) as avg_lpm,
    ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lpm) AS numeric), 2) as median_lpm
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN d.hubcaptons > 0 THEN
            (t.totaldeliverytons::numeric / d.hubcaptons::numeric) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100
        ELSE NULL
        END as lpm
    FROM operations ops
    JOIN transportation t ON ops.opsdistref = t.transportdistref
    JOIN distributionhubs d ON ops.opshubref = d.hubregistry
) sub;

SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(MIN(lpm) AS numeric), 2) as min_lpm,
    ROUND(CAST(MAX(lpm) AS numeric), 2) as max_lpm,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN d.hubcaptons > 0 THEN
            (t.totaldeliverytons::numeric / d.hubcaptons::numeric) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100
        ELSE NULL
        END as lpm
    FROM operations ops
    JOIN transportation t ON ops.opsdistref = t.transportdistref
    JOIN distributionhubs d ON ops.opshubref = d.hubregistry
) sub;

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN lpm <= 500 THEN '0-500'
         WHEN lpm <= 1000 THEN '500-1000'
         WHEN lpm <= 2000 THEN '1000-2000'
         WHEN lpm <= 5000 THEN '2000-5000'
         ELSE '5000+'
    END as bucket,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN d.hubcaptons > 0 THEN
            (t.totaldeliverytons::numeric / d.hubcaptons::numeric) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100
        ELSE NULL
        END as lpm
    FROM operations ops
    JOIN transportation t ON ops.opsdistref = t.transportdistref
    JOIN distributionhubs d ON ops.opshubref = d.hubregistry
) sub
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT 
    ops.opsregistry,
    de.affectedarea,
    s.resourceinventory->'power'->>'generators' as power_generators,
    s.resourceinventory->'essentials'->>'water_liters' as water_liters,
    ROUND(CAST(
        CASE WHEN d.hubcaptons > 0 THEN
            (t.totaldeliverytons::numeric / d.hubcaptons::numeric) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100
        ELSE NULL
        END AS numeric), 2) as lpm
FROM operations ops
JOIN transportation t ON ops.opsdistref = t.transportdistref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON ops.opshubref = d.hubregistry
JOIN supplies s ON ops.opsdistref = s.supplydistref AND ops.opshubref = s.supplyhubref
JOIN disasterevents de ON ops.opsdistref = de.distregistry
WHERE CASE WHEN d.hubcaptons > 0 THEN
        (t.totaldeliverytons::numeric / d.hubcaptons::numeric) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100
    ELSE NULL
END <= 500
ORDER BY lpm ASC;
